mapper.insert: INSERT INTO FILE_META (USER_ID, STORED_FILE_NAME, FILE_PATH, FILE_EXTENSION, FILE_SIZE, FILE_TYPE, ORIGINAL_FILE_NAME) VALUES (#{userId}, #{storedFileName}, #{filePath}, 'pdf', #{fileSize}, #{fileType}, #{originalFileName})
mapper.select: SELECT TAX_INPUT_ID FROM TAX_INPUTS WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND TAX_YEAR = #{taxYear} LIMIT 1
SELECT FILE_ID FROM FILE_META WHERE FILE_ID = #{fileId} AND USER_ID = #{userId} AND DELETED_AT IS NULL AND FILE_TYPE IN ('TAX_LEDGER', 'TAX_EVIDENCE') FOR UPDATE

SELECT TRANSACTION_ID AS transactionId, TAX_INPUT_ID AS taxInputId, USER_ID AS userId, TRANSACTION_TYPE AS transactionType, TRANSACTION_DATE AS transactionDate, DESCRIPTION AS description, CATEGORY AS category, AMOUNT AS amount, TAX_YEAR AS taxYear, IS_EDITED AS edited, SOURCE_FILE_ID AS sourceFileId, SOURCE_ITEM_INDEX AS sourceItemIndex FROM TAX_TRANSACTIONS WHERE SOURCE_FILE_ID = #{fileId} AND SOURCE_ITEM_INDEX = #{itemIndex} AND USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TAX_TRANSACTIONS (TAX_INPUT_ID, USER_ID, TRANSACTION_TYPE, TRANSACTION_DATE, DESCRIPTION, CATEGORY, AMOUNT, TAX_YEAR, IS_EDITED, SOURCE_FILE_ID, SOURCE_ITEM_INDEX) VALUES (#{taxInputId}, #{userId}, #{transactionType}, #{transactionDate}, #{description}, #{category}, #{amount}, #{taxYear}, TRUE, #{sourceFileId}, #{sourceItemIndex})
